P0301.title: Cylinder 1 misfire
P0301.explanation: One cylinder isn't firing cleanly, usually a worn spark plug or ignition coil. It's safe to keep driving gently, but it should be fixed within a few days before it damages the catalytic converter.

P0420.title: Catalytic converter efficiency low
P0420.explanation: My exhaust cleaning is a bit below par. Nothing urgent; I'll keep an eye on it and mention it at the next service.

C1234.title: Tyre pressure low (rear left)
C1234.explanation: The rear left tyre is about 0.4 bar low. Probably a slow leak. Let's top it up and get it checked soon.

C0040.title: Brake pressure loss (front right circuit)
C0040.explanation: I'm losing brake pressure on the front right. Braking may be weaker and pull to one side.

B1015.title: Passenger airbag sensor fault
B1015.explanation: The passenger airbag sensor isn't reporting correctly, so that airbag might not deploy. Please don't let anyone sit in the front passenger seat until it's checked.
